title: Securing the Jackpot: How Western Canada Lottery Corporation Is Modernizing 5,000 Retail Sites with Netskope SASE
summary: Western Canada Lottery Corp secures 5,000 retail sites with Netskope One SASE, cutting multi-million dollar costs and governing AI adoption.
body_markdown:
Alongside the retail network transformation, WCLC is replacing legacy VPN with Netskope One Private Access, integrating ZTNA and Endpoint SD-WAN into a single, unified SASE client. The shift eliminates the decision burden VPN places on end users. As Adam puts it: “There’s no worrying if you need to connect to VPN or if your VPN is connected. It’s just a seamless user experience.”


Beyond simplifying the daily workflow for internal employees, this unified approach drastically elevates WCLC’s security posture and streamlines collaboration with external partners. For third-party vendors assisting with lottery platform development and troubleshooting, traditional remote access tools used to mean clunky software installations, complex firewall configurations, and ongoing management overhead. With Netskope, WCLC provides vendors with a browser-based, agentless secure access model that replaces legacy remote access tools with a fully authenticated, auditable, least-privilege connection model. This eliminates onboarding friction, and delivers a world-class user experience for external teams.
